page.title: Exterminauts: Co-op Alien Pest Control Shooter
page.meta_description: Exterminauts is a 3-player co-op PvE shooter from Behaviour Interactive. Take contracts on Tian, blast alien pests with power tools, and extract.
page.tagline: Punch in, clean up, and get paid with a blue-collar crew of three.
overview: Exterminauts is an upcoming cooperative third-person PvE shooter developed by Behaviour Interactive and published by Level Infinite. Set on the alien planet Tian, the game puts one to three players in the boots of blue-collar galactic workers who take contracts to exterminate alien pests, repair infrastructure, complete objectives, and extract from hazardous worksites.

Combat is built around weaponized power tools and mad-science gadgets. The arsenal includes specialized firearms inspired by industrial equipment, with ice, electricity, anti-gravity, and foam effects. Players can slide, shoot while sliding, roll, use ziplines, and trigger Overdrive abilities that turn ordinary blue-collar gear into alien-shredding weapons.

Tian is described as a living ecosystem that fights back and adapts to your squad’s tactics, so a three-player team has to communicate, reposition, and change strategies to survive. Steam also notes corporate honey traps, blood-soaked pest control, and the cost of every work order: cover your crewmates, tally expenses, and make it through the shift. Exterminauts is scheduled for 2027 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Windows, and Steam currently lists it as coming soon.

how_to_play: Form a crew of one to three Exterminauts.
Take MegaCorp contracts on the alien planet Tian.
Exterminate alien pests, repair infrastructure, and complete mission objectives.
Use power-tool-inspired firearms with ice, electricity, anti-gravity, and foam effects.
Slide, shoot while sliding, roll, use ziplines, and activate Overdrive abilities.
Communicate and reposition as the alien ecosystem adapts to your squad’s tactics.
Extract from the worksite and earn resources.
tips: Cover your crewmates. Steam notes that every work order costs company money, so keep expenses in mind.
Communicate and change strategies often; the alien threat adapts to your squad’s tactics.
Use Overdrive to turn standard blue-collar gear into devastating weapons.
Make the most of movement options like sliding, rolling, and ziplines to reposition.
Use the tool-based arsenal, including ice, electricity, anti-gravity, and foam weapons.

faq.a: Exterminauts is an upcoming cooperative third-person PvE shooter developed by Behaviour Interactive and published by Level Infinite. It is set on the alien planet Tian.
Exterminauts is scheduled to launch in 2027, according to Wikipedia. The Steam store page currently lists it as coming soon.
The game is scheduled for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Windows.

faq.q: How many players can play Exterminauts?
faq.a: Exterminauts is designed for teams of one to three players, with a three-player blue-collar crew at the center of its co-op gameplay.
Steam does not list Exterminauts as free. Pricing has not been announced in the provided sources.
Exterminauts is developed by Behaviour Interactive Inc. and published by Level Infinite.
